channel.title: WWE's Greatest Moments
channel.desc: The incomparable "Rowdy" Roddy Piper stood above all when it came to antagonizing audiences worldwide. The Hot Rod is an all-time WWE Legend, and his antics will be remembered for generations to come. Relive his unforgettable boxing match with Mr. T at WrestleMania 2, his instant classic with Bret "Hitman" Hart, and the talk show that started it all, Piper's Pit!
